request.query: The degree in a remaining variable of a coefficient polynomial obtained by collecting powers of one variable is bounded by the original individual degree.

items.name: MvPolynomial.degreeOf_coeff_finSuccEquiv
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommSemiring R] {n : ℕ} (p : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R) (j : Fin n) (i : ℕ),
  MvPolynomial.degreeOf j (((MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv R n) p).coeff i) ≤ MvPolynomial.degreeOf j.succ p

items.name: MvPolynomial.degreeOf_C_mul_le
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : MvPolynomial σ R) (i : σ) (c : R),
  MvPolynomial.degreeOf i (MvPolynomial.C c * p) ≤ MvPolynomial.degreeOf i p

items.name: MvPolynomial.degreeOf_mul_C_le
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : MvPolynomial σ R) (i : σ) (c : R),
  MvPolynomial.degreeOf i (p * MvPolynomial.C c) ≤ MvPolynomial.degreeOf i p

items.name: MvPolynomial.degreeOf_mul_X_self
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (j : σ) (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  MvPolynomial.degreeOf j (f * MvPolynomial.X j) ≤ MvPolynomial.degreeOf j f + 1

items.name: MvPolynomial.monomial_le_degreeOf
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (i : σ) {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {m : σ →₀ ℕ},
  m ∈ f.support → m i ≤ MvPolynomial.degreeOf i f
